candidate_passages.text: The MIKU preprint reports that limited CXL device parallelism and unfair request handling can interfere with local DDR service; under its heavy-load tests, DDR bandwidth fell by as much as 81 percent. Results depend on the tested platforms and workload conditions.
candidate_passages.candidate_claim: A 2025 preprint reports that CXL and DDR interference can reduce local DDR bandwidth by up to 81% under tested heavy-load conditions, contradicting any assumption that a CXL tier is performance-neutral.
